```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(flowCore)
  library(data.table)
})

# ---- parameters written by cytoflowgui -----------------------------------
cfg <- jsonlite::read_json(params$params_file, simplifyVector = TRUE)

# ---- helpers --------------------------------------------------------------
# shared helpers of cytoflowgui: log_msg, note, as_chr, safe_name, ...
source(file.path(cfg$helpers_dir, "helpers.R"), local = TRUE)

strip_fcs <- function(x) {
  sub("\\.fcs$", "", x, ignore.case = TRUE)
}

# folders of the step, given by cytoflowgui: data = FCS to continue the
# analysis, reports = tables (created when needed)
step_dir <- cfg$step_dir
data_dir <- cfg$data_dir
reports_dir <- cfg$reports_dir
rel_path <- function(x) substring(x, nchar(step_dir) + 2)
stem <- safe_name(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(cfg$fcs_file)))
formats <- tolower(as_chr(cfg$table_formats))
split_mode <- if (is.null(cfg$split_mode)) "none" else cfg$split_mode
```

```{r read, include=FALSE}
# ---- read the FCS --------------------------------------------------------
log_msg("Reading %s", basename(cfg$fcs_file))
ff <- flowCore::read.FCS(
  cfg$fcs_file, transformation = FALSE, truncate_max_range = FALSE,
  emptyValue = FALSE
)
mat <- flowCore::exprs(ff)
pars <- flowCore::parameters(ff)@data
channels <- as.character(pars$name)
desc <- as.character(pars$desc)

for (ch in c(cfg$file_channel, cfg$cluster_channel)) {
  if (!ch %in% colnames(mat)) {
    stop(sprintf("Channel '%s' not found in the FCS file", ch))
  }
}

# markers = channel marker names ($PnS); without any, channel names are used
has_desc <- !is.na(desc) & nzchar(desc)
all_markers <- if (any(has_desc)) {
  data.frame(marker = desc[has_desc], channel = channels[has_desc])
} else {
  data.frame(marker = channels, channel = channels)
}
is_key <- all_markers$channel %in% c(cfg$file_channel, cfg$cluster_channel)
all_markers <- all_markers[!is_key, , drop = FALSE]

# an empty selection means all markers
resolve_markers <- function(sel, what) {
  sel <- as_chr(sel)
  if (!length(sel)) {
    return(all_markers)
  }
  pick <- function(m) {
    i <- match(tolower(m), tolower(all_markers$marker))
    if (is.na(i)) {
      i <- match(tolower(m), tolower(all_markers$channel))
    }
    i
  }
  idx <- vapply(sel, pick, integer(1))
  if (anyNA(idx)) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "%s: marker(s) not found in the FCS file: %s",
        what, paste(sel[is.na(idx)], collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }
  all_markers[unique(idx), , drop = FALSE]
}
markers_heat <- resolve_markers(cfg$mfi_heatmap_markers, "Heatmap markers")
markers_rep <- resolve_markers(cfg$mfi_report_markers, "Report markers")
markers_heat$label <- make.unique(markers_heat$marker)
markers_rep$label <- make.unique(markers_rep$marker)

# cells: keep a row index so that FCS subsets can be written later
ok <- !is.na(mat[, cfg$file_channel]) & !is.na(mat[, cfg$cluster_channel])
if (!all(ok)) {
  note("%d cells without file or cluster value were ignored", sum(!ok))
}
use_ch <- unique(c(markers_heat$channel, markers_rep$channel))
dt <- as.data.table(
  mat[ok, c(cfg$file_channel, cfg$cluster_channel, use_ch), drop = FALSE]
)
setnames(dt, c(".file", ".cluster", use_ch))
dt[, .file := as.integer(round(.file))]
dt[, .cluster := as.integer(round(.cluster))]
dt[, .row := which(ok)]
log_msg("%d cells, %d markers", nrow(dt), length(use_ch))
```

```{r mappings, include=FALSE}
# ---- file and cluster names ----------------------------------------------
# column 1 = integer number, column 2 = name
read_simple_map <- function(path) {
  if (tolower(tools::file_ext(path)) %in% c("xlsx", "xlsm")) {
    x <- as.data.frame(
      readxl::read_excel(
        path, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text"
      )
    )
  } else {
    first <- readLines(path, n = 1, warn = FALSE)
    seps <- c(",", ";", "\t")
    n_sep <- vapply(
      seps,
      function(s) nchar(first) - nchar(gsub(s, "", first, fixed = TRUE)),
      1L
    )
    sep <- if (max(n_sep) == 0) "," else seps[which.max(n_sep)]
    x <- utils::read.table(
      path, sep = sep, header = FALSE, quote = "\"", comment.char = "",
      fill = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = "character",
      fileEncoding = "UTF-8-BOM"
    )
  }
  if (ncol(x) < 2) {
    stop(sprintf("%s: at least two columns are expected", basename(path)))
  }
  no <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x[[1]]))
  keep <- !is.na(no) & no == round(no)   # a header row is dropped here
  data.frame(
    no = as.integer(no[keep]),
    name = trimws(as.character(x[[2]][keep]))
  )
}

file_map <- NULL
if (!is.null(cfg$file_map_file)) {
  if (identical(cfg$file_map_format, "simple")) {
    file_map <- read_simple_map(cfg$file_map_file)
  } else {
    df <- as.data.frame(
      readxl::read_excel(cfg$file_map_file, sheet = cfg$file_map_sheet)
    )
    file_map <- data.frame(
      no = as.integer(df[[cfg$file_map_id_column]]),
      name = trimws(as.character(df[[cfg$file_name_column]]))
    )
  }
}

cluster_map <- NULL
if (!is.null(cfg$cluster_map_file)) {
  if (identical(cfg$cluster_map_format, "simple")) {
    cluster_map <- read_simple_map(cfg$cluster_map_file)
  } else {
    df <- as.data.frame(
      readxl::read_excel(cfg$cluster_map_file, sheet = cfg$cluster_map_sheet)
    )
    names(df) <- tolower(trimws(names(df)))
    in_clustering <- trimws(as.character(df$clustering_id)) ==
      cfg$cluster_channel
    df <- df[in_clustering, , drop = FALSE]
    cluster_map <- data.frame(
      no = as.integer(df$cluster_no),
      name = trimws(as.character(df$cluster_name))
    )
  }
}

# one row per number found in the data; unmapped numbers keep their number
make_labels <- function(ids, map, what, prefix) {
  ids <- sort(unique(ids))
  nm <- rep(NA_character_, length(ids))
  if (!is.null(map)) {
    map <- map[!is.na(map$no) & !duplicated(map$no), , drop = FALSE]
    nm <- map$name[match(ids, map$no)]
  }
  bad <- is.na(nm) | !nzchar(nm)
  if (!is.null(map) && any(bad)) {
    note(
      "%s without a name in the mapping: %s",
      what, paste(ids[bad], collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  nm[bad] <- as.character(ids[bad])
  tag <- if (is.null(map)) {
    paste0(prefix, "_", ids)
  } else {
    paste0(prefix, "_", ids, "_", safe_name(strip_fcs(nm)))
  }
  data.frame(no = ids, name = make.unique(nm), tag = make.unique(tag))
}
fl <- make_labels(dt$.file, file_map, "File numbers", "file")
cl <- make_labels(dt$.cluster, cluster_map, "Cluster numbers", "cluster")
log_msg("%d files, %d clusters", nrow(fl), nrow(cl))
```

```{r tables, include=FALSE}
# ---- tables ---------------------------------------------------------------
cluster_cols <- function(no) {
  data.frame(cluster_no = no, cluster_name = cl$name[match(no, cl$no)])
}

# 1-2. cluster x markers (heatmap markers, all files pooled)
heat_ch <- markers_heat$channel
by_cluster <- function(fun) {
  r <- dt[, lapply(.SD, fun), by = ".cluster", .SDcols = heat_ch]
  setorderv(r, ".cluster")
  m <- as.data.frame(r[, heat_ch, with = FALSE])
  names(m) <- markers_heat$label
  cbind(cluster_cols(r$.cluster), m)
}
tab_mfi <- by_cluster(function(v) median(v, na.rm = TRUE))
tab_iqr <- by_cluster(function(v) IQR(v, na.rm = TRUE))

# 3-4. cluster x files: cell counts and frequencies (% of each file's cells)
cnt <- dt[, .N, by = c(".cluster", ".file")]
count_m <- matrix(0L, nrow(cl), nrow(fl))
count_m[cbind(match(cnt$.cluster, cl$no), match(cnt$.file, fl$no))] <- cnt$N
freq_m <- sweep(count_m, 2, colSums(count_m), "/") * 100
to_tab <- function(m) {
  x <- as.data.frame(m)
  names(x) <- fl$name
  cbind(cluster_cols(cl$no), x)
}
tab_count <- to_tab(count_m)
tab_freq <- to_tab(freq_m)

# 5. (cluster x marker) x files: MFI of the report markers
rep_ch <- markers_rep$channel
mm <- dt[
  , lapply(.SD, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  by = c(".cluster", ".file"), .SDcols = rep_ch
]
long <- melt(
  mm, id.vars = c(".cluster", ".file"), measure.vars = rep_ch,
  variable.name = "channel", value.name = "mfi", variable.factor = FALSE
)
rows <- data.frame(
  cluster_no = rep(cl$no, each = nrow(markers_rep)),
  marker = rep(markers_rep$label, times = nrow(cl)),
  channel = rep(markers_rep$channel, times = nrow(cl))
)
rows$cluster_name <- cl$name[match(rows$cluster_no, cl$no)]
rep_m <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(rows), nrow(fl))
ri <- match(
  paste(long$.cluster, long$channel, sep = "\r"),
  paste(rows$cluster_no, rows$channel, sep = "\r")
)
rep_m[cbind(ri, match(long$.file, fl$no))] <- long$mfi
tab_rep <- as.data.frame(rep_m)
names(tab_rep) <- fl$name
tab_rep <- cbind(rows[, c("cluster_no", "cluster_name", "marker")], tab_rep)

tables <- list(
  "MFI cluster x marker" = tab_mfi,
  "IQR cluster x marker" = tab_iqr,
  "Count cluster x file" = tab_count,
  "Freq (%) cluster x file" = tab_freq,
  "MFI (cluster x marker) x file" = tab_rep
)

# ---- write the tables: one XLSX (one tab per table), and/or one TSV each ---
outputs <- character(0)
if (length(formats)) {
  dir.create(reports_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
if ("xlsx" %in% formats) {
  f <- file.path(reports_dir, paste0(stem, "_tables.xlsx"))
  writexl::write_xlsx(tables, f)
  outputs <- c(outputs, f)
  log_msg("Wrote %s", basename(f))
}
if ("tsv" %in% formats) {
  d <- file.path(reports_dir, paste0(stem, "_tables_tsv"))
  dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
  for (n in names(tables)) {
    tsv_name <- gsub("\\s+", "_", safe_name(gsub("[()%]", "", n)))
    data.table::fwrite(
      tables[[n]], file.path(d, paste0(tsv_name, ".tsv")), sep = "\t"
    )
  }
  outputs <- c(outputs, d)
  log_msg("Wrote TSV tables in %s", basename(d))
}
```

```{r split, include=FALSE}
# ---- split the FCS --------------------------------------------------------
n_fcs <- 0L
if (split_mode != "none") {
  root <- data_dir
  dir.create(root, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  by <- switch(
    split_mode,
    file = ".file",
    cluster = ".cluster",
    c(".file", ".cluster")
  )
  g <- dt[, list(rows = list(.row)), by = by]
  ftag <- function(no) fl$tag[match(no, fl$no)]
  ctag <- function(no) cl$tag[match(no, cl$no)]
  g$path <- switch(
    split_mode,
    file = file.path(root, paste0(ftag(g$.file), ".fcs")),
    cluster = file.path(root, paste0(ctag(g$.cluster), ".fcs")),
    cluster_file = file.path(
      root, ctag(g$.cluster), paste0(ftag(g$.file), ".fcs")
    ),
    file_cluster = file.path(
      root, ftag(g$.file), paste0(ctag(g$.cluster), ".fcs")
    ),
    stop(sprintf("Unknown split mode: %s", split_mode))
  )
  log_msg("Writing %d FCS files", nrow(g))
  step <- max(1L, nrow(g) %/% 10L)
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(g))) {
    dir.create(dirname(g$path[k]), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    flowCore::write.FCS(ff[g$rows[[k]], ], g$path[k])
    if (k %% step == 0L || k == nrow(g)) {
      log_msg("  %d/%d", k, nrow(g))
    }
  }
  n_fcs <- nrow(g)
  outputs <- c(outputs, root)
}
write_session_info(cfg)
```

## Summary

```{r summary}
info <- step_info(
  cfg, "fcs_file",
  c(
    "FCS file" = cfg$fcs_file, "Cells" = format(nrow(dt), big.mark = ","),
    "Files" = nrow(fl), "Clusters" = nrow(cl),
    "File channel" = cfg$file_channel,
    "Cluster channel" = cfg$cluster_channel,
    "Heatmap markers" = paste(markers_heat$marker, collapse = ", "),
    "Report markers" = paste(markers_rep$marker, collapse = ", "),
    "Split mode" = split_mode, "FCS files written" = n_fcs,
    "Step folder" = step_dir
  )
)
knitr::kable(info)
```

## Output

```{r outputs, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- `", rel_path(outputs), "`\n"), sep = "")
```

## Tables

Frequencies are percentages of the cells of each file. MFI is the median
intensity and IQR the interquartile range, both computed on the values stored
in the FCS file. Only the first rows are shown.

```{r preview, results='asis'}
for (n in names(tables)) {
  cat("\n### ", n, "\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(utils::head(tables[[n]], 10), digits = 2))
}
```
